question: What follows if one refuses to cross difficulties by the Lord's grace?
premises: refusal rooted in ego blocks freedom
inference: egoic refusal turns grace-given crossing into bondage and ruin
uncertainties: cettvamahaṅkārāṃ is read as conditional refusal from ego
plain_english: With mind fixed on me you will cross all difficulties by my grace; but if you refuse from ego, you will not be freed and will perish.
